lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑行，身体一扭一扭。
lines.en: I glide low, my body twisting.

lines.zh: 鳞片在草丛里摩擦发声。
lines.en: My scales rasp through the grass.

lines.zh: 我把上半身撑起来，四下看。
lines.en: I raise my front half and look around.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，没有停留。
lines.en: I round a stone without pausing.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后画着弧。
lines.en: My tail draws an arc behind me.

lines.zh: 我穿过落叶堆，叶子翻起来。
lines.en: I cross the leaf litter and it scatters.
I head for the shade.
I crawl along the base of the wall.
I stop and flick my tongue.
I draw my neck in slowly.

lines.zh: 身体的重量让我走得很沉。
lines.en: My weight makes each movement heavy.

lines.zh: 石缝够宽，我扭着身子过。
lines.en: The gap is wide enough; I twist through.
I lift my head and listen to the wind.
I turn toward it, then back.
I move toward deeper shade.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上拖得很长。
lines.en: My shadow trails long on the ground.

lines.zh: 我盘着，头搁在自己身上。
lines.en: I coil with my head resting on myself.
Only my tongue flicks out now and then.
The stone here is cool.
I coil into what looks like a stone.

lines.zh: 我在听地面传上来的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片颜色和土很像。
lines.en: My scales match the soil.
I draw myself tighter.
My eyes close and open, slowly.
There's nothing else nearby.
I lift my head, then settle it back.
The wind passes over my back.
My tongue slips out and back.
I listen to my own breathing.

lines.zh: 太阳移动了，我还在原处。
lines.en: The sun has moved; I haven't.
Tongue flicking, I look straight at you.
You stand rigid; I watch a long while.
So I keep looking at you.

lines.zh: 我一眨不眨，盯着你的手。
lines.en: Unblinking, I watch your hands.
You've stood beside me a long while.

lines.zh: 我把蜷着的身子一寸寸摊开。
lines.en: I unwind my coiled body inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我吐了吐舌头，读你的气味。
lines.en: I flick my tongue to read your scent.
You're not a stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着地，往前蹭了半尺。
lines.en: Low to the ground, I creep half a foot closer.
You should probably step back.
I coil tighter.
A scale splits.
I raise my head and flick my tongue.
Even the pain draws no sound from me.
I retreat behind a stone.

lines.zh: 血从我身体下面渗出来。
lines.en: Blood seeps from beneath me.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子，挪到阴影里。
lines.en: Dragging myself, I move into the shade.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在背上，鳞都翻起。
lines.en: The blow lands on my back and scales lift.
While my blood's warm, I can still crawl.
Head raised, I fix my stare on you.
Something smells.
What you set down, I may not eat.
I scent it first.
This will do.

lines.zh: 我先嗅了嗅，才慢慢挪近。
lines.en: I sniff first, then edge slowly closer.
I don't chew; I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 吃东西时，我不喜欢有人靠近。
lines.en: I don't like company while eating.
Set it down and go; don't stand there.
I'd like some more.
Once fed, I'll go.
You hit me and I coil tight.
My scales scrape audibly.
I raise my head, displeased.
I pull back behind the stone, eyes only.

lines.zh: 撞在鳞上，只留一片白印。
lines.en: It hits my scales and leaves a pale mark.

lines.zh: 我盘紧的身子，一点点松开。
lines.en: My tight coil loosens bit by bit.
Don't bump me again.
I draw my tail back.
Half a step apart, we stare at each other.
I go back to coiling.
My kind aren't common.

lines.zh: 这条路上只有我自己的味道。
lines.en: Only my own scent is on this path.
I coil and wait.

lines.zh: 我等了一阵，只有风回我。
lines.en: I wait, and only the wind answers.
My kind are few; I can wait.
The stone will stay cool.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，换了个地方。
lines.en: I round the stone to another spot.
Still only me.
I close my eyes.
Time means little to me.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，牙尖陷进去。
lines.en: I bite down and my fangs sink in.
As it goes down, it still struggles.
I swallow it whole.
It's stuck in my throat.

lines.zh: 我让喉咙慢慢把它送下去。
lines.en: I let my throat work it down.
Two chews and the shell grates my teeth.
It won't go down; I spit it on the sand.

lines.zh: 我用下巴把它抵在石下。
lines.en: I pin it under the stone with my jaw.
I don't need it.
I rest my head back on my coil.
Something rustles under the dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我从盘里抬起头，盯住它。
lines.en: I lift my head from the coil and fix on it.
My tongue tastes a scent.

lines.zh: 我掉过身，头对着那个方向。
lines.en: I turn my body, head toward it.

lines.zh: 我拉长身子，一点一点靠近。
lines.en: I stretch out and close in bit by bit.
It's smaller than me.
I lower my head and stay still.
Its shadow shifts.
The distance isn't right yet.
I coil my rear half.
Ready.

lines.zh: 它的头转过来，停在我这边。
lines.en: Its head turns and stops on me.
The prey is still there, not gone.
I close in slowly.

lines.zh: 泥土把我的味道盖住了。
lines.en: The soil hides my scent.
Head down, it only walks on.
I raise my front half.

lines.zh: 它的目光扫过来，我压低身子。
lines.en: Its gaze sweeps over; I flatten lower.
I stop.
It looks away again.
Just one more step from it.
My muscles are taut.
It turns; now.
I strike.
I raise my head higher.

lines.zh: 牙合上，正咬在它的小腿。
lines.en: My teeth close on its calf.
My teeth press down.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，把它的腿缠住。
lines.en: I wrap twice around its legs.
It's pressed to its knees.

lines.zh: 它一挣，从我盘里滑出去。
lines.en: It wrenches free of my coil.
I coil again.
This bite sinks my teeth into flesh.
I release my bite and it drags itself back.
It backs a step; I take an inch.

lines.zh: 它跑起来，比我滑得还快。
lines.en: It runs faster than I can slide.
Mid-bite, I stop.
Let it go.

lines.zh: 石缝里渗出凉气，我滑了出来。
lines.en: Cold air seeps from the crack and I slide out.
Soil clings to my scales.

lines.zh: 这地方的光，刺得我眯眼。
lines.en: The light here makes me squint.
I coil and take a look first.

lines.zh: 风从石缝里带来一股生气。
lines.en: The wind brings a living scent through the stones.

lines.zh: 我一节一节把身子摊开。
lines.en: I uncoil myself length by length.
The ground is warm.
I head into the shade.
My tail drags behind.
A heartbeat comes from beyond the stones.
Halfway through, I halt.
I'll watch first.
Then decide.
My tongue tastes it.

lines.zh: 我在地上翻滚，想把火压灭。
lines.en: I roll on the ground to smother the flames.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，鳞片刮响。
lines.en: I hit stone and my scales rasp.
Water floods in and I coil tight.
The blast throws me onto the rocks.
An arrow pins through my scales.

lines.zh: 光锁住我的身体，展不开。
lines.en: Light locks my body so I can't uncoil.
Too hungry to hold my coil.
Lightning strikes and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，身体拉得很直。
lines.en: I fall, my body stretched straight.
